changes: FUB multi-property fix: when a searched-and-picked FUB contact has more than one address on file (e.g. Ross Wood: a Colorado home + a vacant Jacksonville lot at '0 Charles Ave'), the Property Address field no longer silently autofills the first/primary address. A new shared FubAddressChooser component lists every on-file address and lets the agent pick the correct one, with an explicit manual-entry fallback ('None of these — I'll enter the property address myself') for properties not in FUB at all. Wired into Repair Consult, Listing Consult, and Inspections+ FUB pickers. The FUB contacts search endpoint now returns a full `addresses` array per person (kept the old single `address` field for backward compat).

Smart Data: added `parcelNumber` (county Property Appraiser parcel #) and `isVacantLand` fields to property_smart_data, since vacant/zero-address properties (e.g. '0 Charles Ave') have no heated/cooled square footage to enter. SmartDataPanel now shows a 'Vacant land' checkbox that swaps the Heated/Cooled Sqft fields for a required Parcel # field, and the minimum-required-data check branches accordingly (vacant land requires parcel # + lot size; normal properties require heated sqft + lot size).
